records.rationale: Complete original two-file patch reviewed. Preserve Android activity/idle uevents, timestamp/UID reporting, suspend accounting and expired-time output through the final v1 reimplementation, not the obsolete revision-0 layout, public constants or timespec APIs. Pinned netd adds/removes --send_nl_msg rules and consumes all four event fields. Correct absent timer sysfs lookup and notifier initialization in the two recorded adaptations; preserve current native safety checks.

Keep zero-initialized allocations and suspend_time_valid guard so POST_SUSPEND without PREPARE does not consume uninitialized timestamp state. Both constructors use kzalloc; current callback preserves the validity guard and is additionally restricted to regular timers because native boottime alarms need no jiffies adjustment.

All two-file rollback hunks reviewed. Preserve its correction of duplicate revision-1 registration and revision-0 UAPI pollution via native v0/v1 layouts and registration arrays. Its wholesale notification/suspend removal is superseded by cf468a86d072/382e68666b7f and current netd consumers. Do not restore intermediate kmalloc, missing notifications, obsolete BUG_ON or old teardown ordering.

Retain active v1 send_nl_msg UAPI and acceptance of values 0/1; values above 1 fail EINVAL. Native rejects nonzero mode as unsupported, which is incompatible with the positive pinned netd --send_nl_msg caller. Keep native timer-type, timeout/label and same-label timer-type checks; this is userspace protocol compatibility, not historical vendor binary KMI.

Complete core reimplementation retained with native current timer/sysfs/socket APIs and explicit fixes f3f057ef8e9a/f9788ed2879e. Preserve native teardown outside list_mutex, timer shutdown before work/sysfs release, timeout bounds and family-specific registration; keep Android notifier unregister before free. Snapshot sysfs mode only after successful locked lookup; initialize work/timer before PM publication; do not operate on unused regular timer for ALARM_BOOTTIME. Netd provides positive producer/consumer evidence. No live event/suspend test is claimed.
Complete diagnostic-only newline fixes remain in current notification and constructor paths. No permission, buffer limit or timer behavior is changed by this historical patch.

All unique sysfs formatting hunks examined. Retain native sysfs_emit and Android expired-time second field with one jiffies snapshot. Later f3f057ef8e9a copies send_nl_msg under successful lookup/list_mutex to avoid the historical null dereference between list deletion and sysfs removal; all formatting cases are checked separately.

Unique destroy resolution adopts native timer_shutdown_sync, retained. Its sysfs-before-work order is superseded by final 41005643bc9b. Current destroy keeps shutdown then work cancellation then sysfs removal outside list_mutex and unregisters the Android PM notifier first; do not replay the historical order.

Both unique destructor resolutions examined. Preserve native early return for shared references and unlock after final list removal, avoiding waiting for callbacks under list_mutex. The accidentally lost unregister_pm_notifier calls are restored by c6ee14d14edc and reordered by 41005643bc9b. No dangling registered callback is retained.

Complete one-line API rename retained: Android suspend adjustment uses native timer_delete. Destruction separately uses timer_shutdown_sync. Do not restore the removed del_timer spelling or confuse callback-time deletion with final lifetime shutdown.

Both missing notifier unregisters are retained, with final 41005643bc9b ordering before timer shutdown/work cancellation/sysfs removal/free. Native blocking-notifier unregister synchronizes callback lifetime. The earlier intermediate placement after sysfs is superseded.

All six unique timeout/target/checkentry hunks examined. Retain native secs_to_jiffies constructor conversion and Android reset_timer calls needed for activity/UID notifications. 9464026f6aec supplies the same safe conversion inside reset_timer; do not replace Android state transitions with bare mod_timer calls.

Keep secs_to_jiffies in reset_timer so native conversion applies without intermediate info_timeout*1000 multiplication. Existing timeout validation and native timer APIs remain; no restored overflow-prone arithmetic.

Keep native sk_uid for full sockets and current user-namespace conversion, with subsequent cafbae1761e5 null check. Cached sk_uid retains the last socket owner after orphaning as documented locally by the removal of sock_i_uid; do not restore obsolete API behavior or dereference a missing full socket.

Retain full_sk null check before sk_uid, covering native skb_to_full_sk returning NULL for TIME_WAIT or missing full sockets. If no full socket exists the existing cached timer UID remains; this is notification metadata, not an authorization decision.

Retain final destructor ordering: remove list under mutex, unlock, unregister PM callback, shutdown/cancel timer, cancel work, remove sysfs file, then free. Both complete current destructors equal native LTS after removing only Android notifier unregister. This retains native deadlock/lifetime fixes; f3f057ef8e9a separately fixes lookup during the list/sysfs removal interval.

All 16-path changed payloads exactly invert reapplication 06dd5347bd54, whose full patch was reviewed. Temporary NFPROTO_UNSPEC rollback is superseded by native family-specific tables and later 306ed1728e84 IPv6 MARK/NFLOG and TRACE-owner fixes. Preserve native connbytes error return and current registration/unregistration; do not restore the temporary broad-family behavior.

Complete 16-file reapplication reviewed. Native LTS represents family-specific registration/cleanup, CT/NOTRACK table consolidation and connbytes error propagation. Fifteen full files equal LTS; IDLETIMER registration array also equals LTS alongside separately retained Android runtime extension. Keep later 306ed1728e84 correcting IPv6 MARK/NFLOG and TRACE module owner, and c38eb2973c18 NFT_COMPAT_ARP condition; historical reapplication alone had the old wrong-family entries.

adaptations.analysis: List removal precedes sysfs removal, so sysfs show can find no timer. ACK dereferences timer->send_nl_msg after the failed lookup. Copy only when found under list_mutex; do not dereference after unlock. Existing kernfs lifetime draining does not prevent a NULL lookup. This analysis claims a null dereference, not a demonstrated freed-object exploit.

Blocking-notifier registration releases its write semaphore before returning, so callbacks can start immediately. Initialize/arm timer and work first; register afterward. Skip regular-timer adjustment for ALARM_BOOTTIME because it uses ktime_get_boottime and the regular timer is not initialized in that branch. Keep valid-PREPARE guard and native clock/teardown primitives.

security: Retained notification extension widens native interface functionality because current Android netd requests it. Native name/timeout bounds, timer-type checks, family restrictions, timer shutdown and work/sysfs teardown remain. UID is activity metadata and not used here for authorization. Historical old layouts, obsolete APIs and incorrect IPv6 entries are not restored. Generic PM/kernel notifier/alarmtimer implementations are unmodified.
